title: fix(sdk): reject prematurely closed chat streams
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The SDK now rejects chat streams that close without a terminal finish event or [DONE], instead of returning partial text as a completed response. Adds a regression test for early stream closure and bumps the package to 5.1.0-alpha.15.
